cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive. You remember our practice talks: listen before offering it something.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So stop offering water. You used to repeat the same offer louder. Tell it we won't leave it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now you're listening. Give it my chair and tell it the seat comes with us getting tea. You've finally found something to bargain with.

reason: Keep the exact impossible-premise Drive distinct: recruit a useful account, delegate a test, secure earlier-belief credit, force an explanatory choice, or request concrete premise-dependent action. Let old training shape that particular method.
